decisions.state_note: o000: visible window approximately x91–154, y129–192; white interior with a thick black curve along the right side and bottom. Digit identity uncertain.

o001: window approximately x91–154, y97–160. Thick black stroke descends diagonally from upper left toward x147,y145, then continues through lower edge near right side; white elsewhere. Upper structure unknown.

o002: window approximately x91–154, y65–128. Black fragment along upper edge near x92–143; separate thick stroke runs from left edge near y90 diagonally down-right to x137 at bottom. Upper digit structure remains unknown.

o003: window x91–154,y33–96 shows a thick black band rising rightward from about (105,70) to the right edge near y53; small black fragment at lower-left near y91. Left-side connections remain unknown; hypotheses include 3 or 5.

o004: window x59–122,y33–96 shows a thick curved stroke rising from about (74,85) to (94,57), joining a rightward band; its lower branch curves down-right through the bottom near x89. Possible upper-left structure of 5; lower connection needs inspection.

o005: window x59–122,y65–128 shows thick stroke curving from upper-left near (73,72), down-right through (87,98) to right edge near y116. Another black fragment touches top near x97–122. Could be loop or curved upper stroke; right-side connections unknown.
o006: window x91–154,y65–128 shows black along the upper edge to about x145 and a separate thick diagonal descending from (91,91) toward (137,128). Right-side extent of upper stroke remains unknown.

o007: window approximately x123–186,y65–128 is mostly white; black enters at top-left to x146 and at lower-left from y110, widening toward x144 at bottom. No right-side connection is visible between these fragments.
o008: window x123–186,y97–160 shows a thick black stroke entering left near y110 and descending rightward to about x154 at the bottom edge; the rest is white. Lower curve remains unobserved.

o009: window x123–186,y129–192 shows thick stroke bending from top-left toward (150,154), then curving back left to the lower-left edge near y187; white to its right. Lower-left extent remains unknown.
o010: window x91–154,y129–192 shows right-hand black curve descending near x149 and bending left across y181–192. White interior extends through the left edge; lower-left connection is unknown.

o011: window x59–122,y129–192 shows white space above a thick bottom stroke beginning near (75,181) and extending right through the edge. Together with the upper-left bend, descending middle stroke, and lower-right curve recorded earlier, this supports digit 5.
